correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs the noncommutative expansion exactly. From \(\operatorname{tr}(V)=\det(V)=0\), Cayley--Hamilton gives \(V^2=0\); the quartic residual is exactly \(2(UV+VU)^2\). Direct coordinates give \(UV+VU=\operatorname{tr}(U)V+\operatorname{tr}(UV)I_2\). Taking the trace of its square forces \(\operatorname{tr}(UV)=0\), and the converse is immediate. The packaged exact-integer verifier checks the explicit counterexample and 26,244 bounded instances. The infinite claim rests on the symbolic proof, not on enumeration.
